title: 21st Century Jet - Building the Boeing 777 - Full Episode 1
summary: The first episode of the 1996 PBS documentary series on the creation of the Boeing 777. It follows the design, build and certification process, including meetings with subcontractors.
why: Cited in threads on Boeing and engineering management as a long, interesting look at how a modern airliner was built.

quote.text: PBS did an interesting, long documentary filming the build and certification process for the 777.
